blockers.description: Post-Phase-8 regression: admin CLI commands (backfill, backfill-streams, sql, mirror-refresh, mirror-coverage) cannot open the DB while the owner is running. DuckDB takes an exclusive file lock. Empirically verified — docker exec inside the same container still gets 'Conflicting lock is held in PID 1'. None of these commands have actually worked since the 2026-05-25 DuckDB cutover. User has not noticed because operation is through MCP.
blockers.workaround: Stop container -> run admin -> start container. Kaizen verdict: ship this as a wrapper script (Option D) rather than build IPC for ~5 admin events per year.

human_actions_pending.context: Context budget ran out before implementation. Kaizen panel verdict is fully captured in this session's chat and below.

decisions.decision: Don't build IPC / live admin transport; ship Option D (wrapper that does compose stop -> admin <cmd> -> start) instead
decisions.rationale: 5 operator events per year on a box where the operator has root. Building admin HTTP/socket transport + pause/resume protocol + atomic-swap dance is textbook over-engineering. Kaizen verdict, agrees with user pushback on operator-workflow framing all day.

decisions.decision: Compact runs against a stopped owner (not live)
decisions.rationale: Stopping the owner makes compact strictly simpler — no pause/resume protocol, no in-flight MCP request draining, no atomic-swap-with-open-file edge cases. Stop+start sidesteps every hard problem.

decisions.decision: Merge admin backfill + admin backfill-streams into 'admin catchup'; delete admin mirror-refresh
decisions.rationale: Two backfill commands distinguish 'missing rows' vs 'missing channels of existing rows' — real data-engineering distinction but irrelevant to a single user who runs this once a year. mirror-refresh is a footgun (refresh worker already runs in-process).

decisions.decision: Internal naming: run_backfill -> run_catchup OK; run_backfill_stream_channels -> _fetch_missing_stream_channels (NOT 'enrich' — that's data-warehouse jargon)
decisions.rationale: Kaizen called out 'enrich' as obscuring jargon. Internal phase names should be plain English: '_fetch_missing_activities' + '_fetch_missing_stream_channels' as the two phases inside run_catchup.

decisions.decision: Stage enum values (STREAMS_BACKFILL, DETAILS_BACKFILL, etc.) stay as-is
decisions.rationale: They're persisted as strings in refresh_state.checkpoint_stage. Renaming = migration, ratio-cost too high for cosmetics.

decisions.decision: DB bloat is a one-time aftermath of the 2026-05-25 Phase 8 SQLite->DuckDB migration, NOT an ongoing problem
decisions.rationale: read_model_refresh_runs timeline shows the bulk was 25 May (601 activities re-materialized + 13 backfill-channel passes of 25 acts each). Day-in-day-out since: 1 activity per refresh. Steady-state bloat is negligible. The 680 MB sits there until something triggers compact.

decisions.decision: weekly_digest is not slower because of inefficiency; it does more work by design (bucket=week => time_bucket() per row + GROUP BY N buckets vs bucket=all_time => constant bucket, 1 group). p95 ~75 ms passes the 100 ms gate with margin. Leave it.
decisions.rationale: Profile-confirmed via cProfile + per-bundle wall-clock. No fix needed — would require pre-materializing weekly buckets (structural change).
